building: Lawson Hall / Richard and Patricia Lawson Computer Science Building

changes.action: Added an illustrative glass display case and two touchscreen kiosks.
changes.evidence: Purdue's 2006 building dedication describes interactive direction/information touchscreens and a display case for Purdue memorabilia in the Kurz Lobby.
changes.limits: Exact number, placement, dimensions and present condition are not established by the sources; all fixture geometry and layout are illustrative.

changes.feature: Roof, exterior shell and stairs evidence metadata
changes.action: Tagged eleven roof/shell/vertical envelope objects as schematic and height/current-roof unverified. Tagged each of the 57 first-floor stair mesh pieces and six landing meshes as schematic, with vertical continuity unverified.
changes.evidence: Purdue's available first-floor plan gives stair locations only. Checked photo/plan sources do not provide measured elevations or complete current upper-floor plans.
changes.limits: No shell, roof, penthouse or equipment height geometry was changed or claimed as measured. Overall model Z maximum remains 21.30 m, unverified. No continuous floor-to-floor stair path is claimed.

changes.action: Reframed the saved detail camera face-on and slightly wider so all four rows and all sixteen modules are legible; the model remains a 4 x 4 grid with documented 16 x 9 ft overall size.
changes.evidence: Purdue CS 2011 article reports a 16 x 9 ft wall, sixteen 46-inch LCD monitors, and 4 x 4 layout.
changes.limits: This represents the documented 2011 installation only. Current hardware and screen content are unverified; module mounting arrangement is illustrative.

changes.action: Adjusted the schematic helical form to a fuller 2.2-turn coil with a thicker stainless section. Reopened-mesh bounds measure 3.047 m high, within 0.001 m of the source-reported 10 ft (3.048 m).
changes.evidence: Purdue CS 2006 article identifies the stainless, brushed/textured Echo Spiral and says it was installed in the lobby directly in front of the main entrance; Purdue dedication reports 10 ft.
changes.limits: The 10 ft overall height is source-backed. Turn count, tube/ribbon section, profile, base and precise floor location are illustrative; this is not an exact surface reconstruction.

changes.action: Raised the whole first-floor cutaway exposure and key/fill illumination; refreshed the lobby and entry preview lighting.
changes.evidence: Lighting/render-only staging makes the plan-derived first floor and fixtures more readable.
changes.limits: Preview lights and cameras are temporary and are not saved to the asset. Cutaway remains a schematic L1 visualization; no vertical stair continuity is demonstrated.
